📖 How this report works

What it shows

Every vendor that sells a part (the part's Vendors tab): the vendor's part number, when the part was last bought from it and at what cost, and the unit that cost is for. It is the BI version of the standard Part Vendor List and reads the same data the same way. Vendor Part List is its mirror image: a vendor's parts.

Last Sold and Cost

They are the last cost Fishbowl keeps on the part's Vendors tab. Fishbowl updates it when a purchase order with the part is issued or saved and when its receipt is reconciled; editing or importing the vendor part changes it too. Last Sold is when that happened.

  • The cost is in the vendor's currency; a cost in another currency than your home one shows its code (e.g. $37.95 USD).
  • It is per the vendor part's UOM, which may differ from the part's own (a case, a drum…).
  • Cost in home currency per part UOM (an extra column) puts every vendor on the same footing: converted at today's exchange rate and to the part's own unit, so the cheapest vendor is plain to see. A zero cost (none recorded) is left out of it.
Using it
  • Filters → Part number: pick one part, type a pattern with % (e.g. B2%), or leave it empty for every part with a vendor. Opened from a part (its Apps menu) the report shows that part and it can't be changed.
  • Opened for a vendor from the Vendor module, it lists the parts that vendor sells, each with all of its vendors; the vendor's own rows are marked this vendor.
  • Click a part's row to show or hide its vendors; Expand / Collapse do every part. Click a part or vendor to open it.
  • Click a column heading to sort the vendors within each part (again to reverse, a third time for vendor order): sort Cost in home currency to put the cheapest first. Drag a heading onto another to move the column; drag a heading's right edge to resize it. Your layout is remembered; Settings → Reset column layout undoes it.
  • The Table / Pivot selector switches to a pivot: part × vendor with each vendor's cost in home currency per part UOM, the Total column giving each part's lowest. Change it to the lead time or a count, by any two of part, vendor, vendor part #, default vendor, UOM, currency and Last Sold. Click a figure to see the vendor parts behind it. Print, PDF and Excel follow the view on screen.
  • The App / PDF buttons in the header switch between this interactive view and the printable pages, laid out like the standard report. In PDF view pick the paper size and orientation in the bar above the pages; they are remembered. Print prints those pages.
  • A very large result shows its first 10,000 or so vendor parts (whole parts) with a Load all button.
